name: linkedin-godmode-plugin
description: Agent-operated generic browser and HTTP primitives for personal LinkedIn workflows using local Chrome, Browserbase, or Anchor Browser.

interface.shortDescription: Generic browser and HTTP control for personal LinkedIn workflows
interface.longDescription: Operate a dedicated local Chrome profile, Browserbase, or Anchor Browser through generic browser, network, JavaScript, HTTP, and explicit hosted-task primitives. Includes deterministic no-AI CLI batch execution and capture-first agent skills.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my LinkedIn session and use generic browser primitives to complete my request.
Capture the relevant browser traffic, then replay only the request I explicitly ask for.
Run a deterministic no-AI browser batch using my dedicated profile.
